selection_protocol: same-task SkillOpt keep/revert gate; jpg-ocr-stat uses 44-field accuracy

raw_runs.role: original complete Gold15 run; all 14 non-JPG task selections remain unchanged
replacement jpg-ocr-stat run using the published multimodal diagnosis package, 65 parent-iteration execution cap, and 44-field accuracy verifier

provenance_notes: This composite changes only jpg-ocr-stat. The other 14 task bundles, results, trajectories, and selections are inherited byte-for-byte from the 2026-10-08 Gold15 run.
The superseded Gold15 aggregate and original JPG result are retained as historical evidence; they are not overwritten or mixed into the replacement task record.

The refreshed JPG score is continuous field accuracy over 44 date/amount fields. Its task_passed flag is true only at reward 1.0, so aggregate interpretation should use the per-task reward as well as pass/fail.
No public three-group JPG generalization set was used for diagnosis, repair, candidate selection, or this composite score.
